description: Convert SVG markup into a React component, like SVGR: attributes are camelCased (stroke-width to strokeWidth, xlink:href to xlinkHref, class to className), inline styles become style objects, {...props} is spread onto the root <svg>, and the result is wrapped in `const Name = (props) => (...)` with a default export (optionally TypeScript with SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>). By default it strips the XML prolog, comments, <metadata> and Inkscape/Sketch/Illustrator editor data. Options can set width/height to 1em (adding a viewBox when missing), remove them, or replace fill/stroke colors with currentColor. Returns the component code, the bare JSX and warnings. Does not optimize path data.

cleanup.description: Remove comments, <metadata> and editor data (default true)

currentColor.description: Replace fill/stroke colors with currentColor (default false)

dimensions.description: Root width/height: keep, remove, or set to 1em (default "keep")

svg.description: The SVG markup to convert (a full .svg file is fine)

typescript.description: Emit TypeScript with props typed as SVGProps<SVGSVGElement> (default false)

name: svg_to_react
